name: nvm
description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.
one_liner: A small script that lets a developer switch between different versions of Node.js on their computer.
buyer: No real external buyer — this is free developer infrastructure used internally by programmers, not a product anyone pays for.
business_use_cases: A dev team standardizes onboarding scripts around it so every new hire gets the right Node version instantly.
A bootcamp includes it in setup instructions for students.
No real third-party commercial use case beyond internal developer convenience.

money_ideas.idea: None viable — it's a free, ubiquitous utility; monetizing it directly isn't realistic.

steal_this: Nothing to build here — it's foundational dev tooling, not a business opportunity.
